claims.verbatim: The early universe was not made of atoms.
In the first microseconds, quarks and gluons existed in a plasma too hot for binding.
No stable structures. No persistent distinctions.
Everything that formed was immediately destroyed by the energy density.
Three minutes in: nucleosynthesis.
Protons and neutrons bind into helium, deuterium, trace lithium.
But electrons are still free  -  the universe is a hot plasma where light cannot travel because photons scatter off free electrons constantly.
No signal can propagate. No information can be stored durably. The universe is opaque.
380,000 years in: recombination.
The universe cools enough for free electrons to bind to protons.
Hydrogen forms.
For the first time, a distinction is STABLE  -  this electron belongs to this proton, not that one.
And the photons, released from their scattering prison, travel freely for the first time.
The universe becomes transparent.
Light can carry information.
Those photons are still visible.
The cosmic microwave background  -  the oldest light in the universe  -  is literally the receipt from the universe's first act of stable information storage.
A1.1 (Existence) does not "happen" at the Big Bang.
A1.1 is ontologically primitive  -  it grounds the Big Bang, it is not produced by it.
But the Big Bang is what A1.1 LOOKS LIKE from inside the physical layer.
A1.2 (Distinction) projects physically as particle differentiation.
The quark-gluon plasma is undifferentiated  -  distinction exists but cannot stabilize.
Recombination is the moment distinction HOLDS.
The electron is not the proton. The binding is not the separation. This is not that  -  and for the first time, the universe can remember the difference.
A1.3 (Information = registered distinction) projects as the first stable hydrogen atom.
A registered distinction IS information (the axiom chain's derivation).
Hydrogen is the universe's first durable information storage  -  this electron bound to this proton, a fact the universe will not forget.
T3.1 (Coherence cannot self-increase) projects as the photon release.
When the electron binds to the proton, energy is released as a photon.
Structure gained, entropy paid.
The binding is not free.
The CMB is the cost-of-coherence written across the entire sky.
Every binding event in physics has this signature  -  something gains coherence, something else gets released.
Law 5 (thermodynamics) says you cannot get structure without paying entropy somewhere else.
Law 4 (strong force) says binding has a cost  -  confinement.
Hydrogen is the first transaction. Order purchased, light released.
The receipt (CMB) is still visible 13.8 billion years later.
The axiom chain has an open time node: A1.1 + A1.2 + TR -> TIME, with TR reserved for David to specify.
Recombination gives a candidate for TR: actualization.
Existence + Distinction alone give the POSSIBILITY of information.
The moment particles actually bind  -  that's actualization, and the photon's timestamp IS the first tick of physical time.
David's Aug 9 ruling says time is "what the Trinity's coupling produces."
The first coupling that produces a durable result in the physical universe is recombination.
The photon's release marks the first moment the universe has a RECORD  -  and a record is what makes time real rather than merely possible.
Before recombination, the universe is opaque  -  photons scatter, no signal propagates, no information travels.
After recombination, the universe is transparent  -  light carries information freely.
A5.1 says distinctions must be registerable by an observer to be actualized.
Before transparency, the universe cannot observe itself  -  every photon is scattered before it can carry a message.
After transparency, observation becomes possible.
The universe's first act of seeing is the CMB.
At recombination, the universe crosses the threshold from "distinctions exist but cannot be observed" to "distinctions are observable and therefore actualizable."
The observer requirement (A5.1) and the information requirement (A1.3) both activate at the same moment in the physical timeline.
The strong force coupling constant being off by 1% would mean no stable hydrogen.
No hydrogen means no first registered distinction.
A1.3 never projects into physics.
The fine-tuning numbers protect the axiom chain's physical projection  -  they are the tolerances within which existence + distinction can produce stable information.
The Big Bang IS A1.1 (ontological primitives don't "happen")
Recombination IS A1.3 (the axiom is ontologically prior; recombination is its physical projection)
The CMB proves T3.1 (the CMB is consistent with T3.1; consistency is not proof)
TR = actualization is established (it's a candidate, formation-stage, reserved for David)
